func verify_current_trees():
				for character in saved_stats.characters:
								print("Verifying trees for character:", character)
								Globals.selected_character_name = character
								var stats = get_active_stats()
								_migrate_mutation_tree_loadout(stats)
								var loadout = stats.mutation_tree_loadout
								var prev_active = loadout.active
								for tree in loadout.trees:
												loadout.active = tree.name
												tree.passives = get_connected_nodes()
								loadout.active = prev_active
								var s_tree = stats.specialization_loadout
								s_tree.passives = get_connected_specialization_nodes()
								print("DONE Verify")
